data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Velasquez Wool Rug in Rust color issue](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a29a21bcba105143f418ba8)
Fed Ex had an unreadable label on the carpet we ordered, which resulted in a long delay i arriving. Two customer service people, Archie and Emily, were great in tracking down the problem and communicating. Five stars for them. 

 However, when the 8'x10' Velasquez Wool Rug in Rust finally arrived the color was totally different than the on line photo, or for that matter the name. It is in no way rust - it's a very light tan color.

May 29, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 10, 2026

Hi Diane,

Thank you for your feedback! We are glad that our Customer support team was able to assist you in tracking your order. I can see how the color discrepancy of the rug would be disappointing. Please note that the rug is eligible for a free return, and we are happy to help with that process if you wish.

Lulu and Georgia
